long_biography.plain_text:
Michael Lemos is the only active person with significant control over C.M. Lemos & Company, with ownership of at least three quarters of its shares. He no longer serves as a director, having left the board in 2016, so his current position is more clearly that of a controlling shareholder than a day-to-day manager.

His continuing connection to the maritime sector is also visible through the London P&I Club. He serves on its Members' Committee after earlier service on the association's board. These are industry governance roles, while ships and other assets managed through family companies remain corporate property rather than personally held assets.
